{{Quote|Jeehd-ay&hellip;|The Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
The '''Ravager Chieftain''' was a [[Flesh Raider]] who lived on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the native was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] in a [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|battle]] during the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] of [[3643 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Kill Jeehd-ay!|The Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Flesh Raider]], the Ravager Chieftain commanded other Force-wielding Adepts in the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]<ref name="Enemy Force" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]], who was commanding the natives' invasion in order to destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], gave the chieftain a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and sent the group to an [[ancient shrine]] near the ruins of the temple [[Kaleth]] to learn from the device.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

[[File:Force_Flesh_Raider.png|thumb|left|250px|The Ravager Chieftain fought against the Jedi.]]
However, the Flesh Raider and Adepts were interrupted by the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], who had been sent to investigate activity in the area. The Jedi was astonished to hear the Flesh Raider speak, as the Order had believed the natives were not [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. The Ravager Chieftain then [[Telekinesis/Legends|blasted]] the Padawan with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|attacking]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with the Adepts. However, the Chieftain and Adepts were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Padawan, and the holocron was recovered off of the Chieftain's corpse by Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]].<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Personality and traits==
The Ravager Chieftain had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and grey skin with white stripes.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Flesh Raider was able to use the Force to push his opponents and to use a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] to attack them.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Equipment==
The Ravager Chieftain wore orange and blue [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The Flesh Raider was also armed with a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]].<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ravager Chieftain appears in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "Enemy Force." There are multiple dialogue options with the Ravager Chieftain that the player can choose, but they do not change the Chieftain's response or player's alignment.<ref name="Enemy Force" />
